pipeline.title: Baby Elephants' Funniest First Moments 🐘
selectedMoments: Nobody enjoys life quite like a baby elephant discovering the world for the first time.
Every puddle is a swimming pool, every slope is a slide, and balance is very much a work in progress.
The confidence is enormous, the coordination is not, and honestly, that combination is impossible not to love.

postingPackage.description:
Nobody enjoys life quite like a baby elephant discovering the world for the first time. Every puddle is a swimming pool, every slope is a slide, and balance is very much a work in progress. The confidence is enormous, the coordination is not, and honestly, that combination is impossible not to love. Pure joy, zero worries.
